title: No-wick directional candle
description: A bar whose body occupies at least body_to_range_ratio_min of the bar range and whose upper and lower wicks are each at most wick_to_range_ratio_max of the bar range. The bar range must also be at least min_range_atr_multiple of ATR.
thesis: A bar that opens at one extreme and closes at the other was directional for its whole duration, with no return to the opening area. That absence of retracement inside the bar is the measurable trace of one-sided participation.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: High of the evaluated bar, used for the upper wick.
Low of the evaluated bar, used for the lower wick.
Average true range over atr_period, used to scale the minimum bar range.

parameters.name: wick_to_range_ratio_max
parameters.description: Maximum length of either wick divided by the total bar range. This is the measurable definition of no wick: a wick is permitted up to this fraction and no further.

parameters.name: body_to_range_ratio_min
parameters.description: Minimum body length, the absolute difference of open and close, divided by the total bar range.

parameters.name: min_range_atr_multiple
parameters.description: Minimum total bar range as a multiple of ATR, so a bar too compressed to express direction cannot satisfy the ratios by rounding.

parameters.name: atr_period
parameters.description: Lookback of the average true range used by min_range_atr_multiple, in bars of the evaluated timeframe.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: LONG when candle.close is above candle.open; SHORT when candle.close is below candle.open. A bar whose close equals its open cannot satisfy body_to_range_ratio_min and therefore never matches.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: True when the body and both wick conditions hold on the evaluated bar.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: LONG for an up bar, SHORT for a down bar.

fields.name: body_ratio
fields.description: Body length divided by the total bar range.

fields.name: upper_wick_ratio
fields.description: Upper wick length divided by the total bar range.

fields.name: lower_wick_ratio
fields.description: Lower wick length divided by the total bar range.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Each ratio condition, its threshold and whether it held.

deterministic_test_cases.description: Bar range 10.0, body 9.0 (0.9), upper wick 0.5 (0.05), lower wick 0.5 (0.05), ATR 8.0.
Bar range 10.0, body 9.0 (0.9) closing downward, upper wick 0.5, lower wick 0.5, ATR 8.0.
Bar range 10.0 with an upper wick of 3.0 (0.3), which fails the 0.1 threshold.
Ratios all pass but the bar range of 1.0 is 0.125 of an ATR of 8.0, failing the 0.5 ATR floor.

provenance.source_reference: PID.md line 55 — no-wick candle; and PID.md line 242, the no-wick directional confirmation step of acceptance example B.
provenance.notes: Architect-set defaults. No wick is a proportion, not an absolute: a bar with a wick of zero length is vanishingly rare, so the term is expressed as wick_to_range_ratio_max with an architect-set default of 0.1 and no evidential support yet.
